g.text: UML sequence — Unknown outcome recovery, settlement matching and GL (proposed)
Claim RECONCILING instruction / aged pending item
Original operation, hold and provider reference/key
Inquire original instruction and settlement evidence
Keep restriction; schedule bounded inquiry and escalation
Persist verified evidence with receipt identity
Release original hold once by operation key
Evidence(ref, amount, currency, business date, finality)
Validate reference, amount, currency and rail policy
Commit balanced entries + consume hold atomically if absent
Reconciliation inputs with stable journal/evidence refs
Match instruction / settlement / journal; persist mapping version
Export balanced batch with unique source references
Persist GL acknowledgement and completeness result
Create classified break with immutable evidence refs
Assign severity, age, next action and authority
Verify independent checker for controlled adjustment
New unique correction operation linked to original batch
Commit new balanced batch; preserve original
Evidence-backed disposition; retry match or keep open
Lost core acknowledgement: query the same business key.
Unknown provider status: no new payment or unsafe hold release.
A later return uses a linked movement and its own unique posting.
Duplicate file/export ingestion must not double-book. Late evidence versions stay attributable.
